ClientResponses.Response:
Hello,thank you for taking your time to submit your review! Seeing how your grill is located in a coastal and humid area, additional maintenance will be needed to keep up the appearance of the exterior steel parts. Below are a couple helpful tips.
1. At the first sign of staining/discoloration/surface rust we would recommend cleaning with stainless steel cleaner (ex. Noxon 7). Once cleaned, we recommend using a stainless steel polish (ex. Weber's brand) to keep it looking its best in-between cleanings.
2. Once a week we would recommend wiping down the grill with a wet towel or rag and then drying completely.
3. We would only recommend covering your grill if you know inclement weather is coming. 
4. The quicker you get at a stain the easier it will be to clean off.
If you have any further questions or need assistance, be sure to let our support team know. If you have not already, be sure to register your grill and activate your warranty with us! We sincerely appreciate you choosing Weber and welcome to the Weber Family!
ClientResponses.Name: WeberGrills

Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
